title: 321672 - MECANICA OU MECANICO I São Luís - MA Full-time employee em são luís (MA)
description:
Job description

Você sabia que o nosso time é o que temos de maior valor?

Por isso, respeitamos, valorizamos e investimos em cada pessoa que nos ajuda a transformar a logística do país.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar inspeções técnicas em vagões ferroviários, identificando falhas, desgastes e anomalias, bem como executar atendimentos corretivos e preventivos para garantir a segurança, confiabilidade e disponibilidade operacional da frota;
  • Efetuar diagnósticos, reparos, substituições, ajustes e testes em componentes mecânicos, hidráulicos e pneumáticos, registrando as atividades realizadas e coletando dados para monitoramento das condições dos ativos;
  • Apoiar atendimentos emergenciais, operar equipamentos de movimentação de carga quando habilitado e cumprir os procedimentos de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente, além de executar atividades correlatas à sua área de atuação;
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em vagões;
  • Efetuar montagem, desmontagem, regulagem e testes de componentes;
  • Registrar resultados de inspeções, diagnósticos e intervenções realizadas;
  • Garantir a disponibilidade e segurança operacional da frota de vagões;
  • Cumprir procedimentos, normas e padrões de segurança ferroviária;
  • Apoiar as operações ferroviárias com foco na rápida liberação dos ativos.

Requirements and skills

  • Formação: Ensino Médio Completo + Curso Profissionalizante Mecânica;
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em Manutenção Ferroviária;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno;
  • Residir em São Luís/MA ou ter disponibilidade para mudança;

Additional information

Nossos benefícios valorizam nosso time, por isso oferecemos:

  • Cartão refeição (VR: dedicado a refeições diárias e aceitos em restaurantes, padarias, e similares, ou refeição na empresa: fornecido e realizado na empresa – a depender do site em que irá trabalhar)
  • Vale alimentação (equivalente a cesta básica e aceitos em supermercados, mercearias, açougues, e similares)
  • Vale transporte e/ou ônibus fretado (a depender da localização do site em que irá trabalhar)
  • Plano de previdência complementar (previdência privada, com intuito de “apoiar” em segurança financeira)
  • Assistência médica e odontológica (destinada a seus dependentes diretos – cônjuge, filhas e filhos)
  • Conexa Saúde – Telemedicina para os funcionários e seus dependentes
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados (PLR, focado em metas da empresa, metas da área e metas individuais)
  • Benefício de natal (cesta de natal e cartão presente para filhos)
  • Wellhub (plataforma de academias, com foco em sua saúde e bem estar)
  • Desenvolvimento profissional (por meio da nossa Universidade Corporativa)
  • Programa Bem Cuidar: Assistência psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e nutricional – Para os funcionários e seus dependente
  • Programa de Recrutamento Interno.
  • Licença maternidade estendida para mulheres da VLI (além das mães que geraram seus filhos, o benefício também acolhe mães e pais adotivos)
  • Auxílio creche /ou Auxílio babá (Benefício concedido às empregadas e homens viúvos, ou que tenham a guarda judicial dos filhos)
  • Rede de descontos (descontos exclusivos para os funcionários VLI nos parceiros: Escolas, agências de viagens, aluguel de carros, lojas, restaurantes, salões, e outros)

Estamos em busca de pessoas apaixonadas por desafios, com foco em resultados e engajamento para seguir o nosso propósito de transformar a logística do país. Pessoas que queiram ser protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento profissional, construindo um legado de valor para todos os nossos públicos. Isso tudo em um ambiente desafiador, dinâmico, que oferece autonomia e ambiente flexível, evocê terá a oportunidade de fazer parte de uma das 150 melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil certificada pela GPTW. Topa o desafio?

Conexões que geram valor!

Aqui na VLI valorizamos todas as pessoas, perfis e experiência, pois sabemos que nossas diferenças nos tornam uma empresa mais inovadora, integrada e forte. Por isso, buscamos ampliar a participação de todas as pessoas em nossos processos seletivos, e valorizamos todo o tipo de diversidade: Gênero, raça/etnia, orientação sexual, gerações, religões, pessoas com deficiência.

Venha ser você. Vem ser VLI!

Com os pneus fornecidos, a Continental faz uma contribuição significativa para a mobilidade segura, eficiente e ecológica.

title: Analista Tesouraria Sr em paraná (RN)
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Olos é uma empresa brasileira focada em oferecer soluções de relacionamento entre empresas e seus clientes. Criada a partir de extensas experiências vividas em operações de Televendas, Cobranças, SAC e Helpdesk, nossa plataforma unifica todas as formas de comunicação entre clientes e empresas, e promove o amplo gerenciamento da jornada do cliente, oferecendo uma solução verdadeiramente Omnichannel (Olos Channel).

Fundada em 2010, a Olos surgiu como uma startup e carrega o espírito de superação constante em sua cultura organizacional. Em poucos anos, conquistou uma posição privilegiada no mercado, tornando-se preferência de empresas e organizações.

Hoje, cerca de 60.000 pessoas acessam a plataforma Olos todos os dias, em mais de 110 empresas no Brasil, Peru, Equador, Colômbia, Chile, Argentina ,México, República Dominicana, Paraguai e Portugal.

Qual será seu objetivo?

Gerir estrategicamente a liquidez da companhia, assegurando a proteção, a rentabilidade e a previsibilidade financeira do negócio. Como Analista de Tesouraria Sênior, você será o guardião analítico do fluxo de caixa, liderando o relacionamento com instituições financeiras, dominando produtos bancários complexos e garantindo extrema precisão nos reports de caixa, conciliações e rotinas de fechamento. Seu papel é atuar como um parceiro direto da liderança (CFO/Diretoria) para apoiar tomadas de decisão em um ambiente de tecnologia de ritmo acelerado.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão e Projeção de Fluxo de Caixa: Elaborar, analisar e consolidar o fluxo de caixa diário, semanal e mensal (direto e indireto). Garantir a modelagem e a previsibilidade de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Abertura, Fechamento e Reports Gerenciais: Conduzir as rotinas críticas de abertura e fechamento de caixa com precisão absoluta. Estruturar e apresentar reports periódicos e dashboards executivos de KPIs, provendo visibilidade em tempo real sobre a posição de liquidez.
  • Produtos Bancários e Investimentos: Gerir ativamente o portfólio de investimentos para rentabilizar excedentes de caixa, em conformidade com as políticas da empresa. Estruturar e analisar operações de captação, capital de giro, risco sacado, fianças, operações de Câmbio e Hedge.
  • Relacionamento e Negociação Bancária: Atuar com postura sênior e excelente desenvoltura como ponto focal junto aos bancos. Analisar tarifas, spreads, linhas de crédito, além de gerenciar aberturas/encerramentos de contas, KYC e poderes bancários.
  • Conciliação e Compliance de Alta Complexidade: Garantir a conciliação bancária impecável e a correta contabilização sistêmica. Auditar processos de pagamentos e recebimentos, garantind a conformidade com as políticas de governança e controles internos antifraude.
  • Visão Integrada: Interagir estrategicamente com Contas a Pagar, Contas a Receber e Controladoria, garantindo que as premissas operacionais se reflitam com exatidão nas projeções do caixa.

Requisitos Indispensáveis

  • Formação superior completa em Matemática, Estatística, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio absoluto em Faturamento no ERP Omie: É imprescindível saber lançar, classificar e baixar títulos com total autonomia, segurança e domínio técnico no módulo de Contas a Pagar do sistema.
  • Relacionamento: Habilidade comprovada de comunicação fluida, negociação e trato comercial direto com clientes (B2B) e áreas internas.
  • Experiência prévia em Contas a Pagar: Bagagem profunda em Gestão de Régua de Cobrança e rotinas de Conciliação Bancária.
  • Matemática Financeira e Excel: Domínio em cálculos financeiros e Excel Avançado para análise de dados.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados: Raciocínio lógico apurado e organização.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI/Tableau) para indicadores de cobrança;
  • Inglês ou espanhol intermediário (foco em atendimento a clientes LATAM/Europa);
  • Ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial: Conhecimento prático ou forte interesse no uso e criação de automações com IA (Lovable, Claude, Base44 e criação de agentes autônomos) aplicadas à otimização de rotinas financeiras.

Regime de Contratação

CLT

description:
Executivo(a) de Contas Estratégicas - (Farmer) - Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD)

Nosso modo de fazer no time

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência

Seu Cardápio Diário

  • Gestão Estratégica da Carteira (Foco Principal): Gerenciar e desenvolver uma carteira de contas estratégicas composta por grandes marcas e restaurantes parceiros nas cidades de atuação. O foco principal é a atuação consultiva, construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo e ganho de confiança dos stakeholders sêniores.
  • Atendimento e Consultoria de Vendas: Realizar diagnósticos analíticos e consultivos para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e apresentar o ecossistema completo de produtos (tecnologia, financeiros, turbo, hits, totens, etc.).
  • Análise Crítica e KPIs: Monitorar e analisar diariamente os principais indicadores de performance do negócio, tais como: pedidos, faturamento, conversão, cancelamentos, % de chamados, ROI e investimentos.
  • Geração de Receita e Rentabilidade: Focar na rentabilização da carteira por meio da venda de múltiplos produtos/serviços (cross-sell e up-sell) e captação de alavancas de investimento/exclusividade, garantindo o crescimento do faturamento.
  • Prospecção Oportunista (Perfil Secundário): Mapear e buscar novas oportunidades de negócios e parceiros estratégicos no mercado para complementar a gestão da carteira (Farmer/Grower), atuando de forma pontual conforme a orientação da liderança (posição com perfil majoritariamente consultivo, não sendo puramente Hunter).
  • Rotina de Campo Disciplinada: Realizar visitas diárias e contínuas aos parceiros comerciais, mantendo uma rotina de campo intensa para garantir a proximidade e o resultado.
  • Desenvolvimento de Mercado e Inteligência Competitiva: Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e movimentos do mercado local para adaptar estratégias comerciais e garantir a competitividade de preços e ofertas.
  • Resolução de Conflitos Complexos: Atuar na condução de atritos, negociações complexas e resolução de problemas de forma consultiva com stakeholders sêniores dos parceiros.
  • Foco em Resultado e Autonomia: Forte senso de Dono(a), disciplina para autogestão da agenda e foco na superação de metas e resultados.
  • Negociação e Influência: Habilidade comprovada em negociações complexas com alto poder de influência e condução de conversas consultivas com stakeholders diversos.
  • Resiliência e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de prosperar em ambientes de alta cobrança, ritmo acelerado e constante mudança, mantendo a inteligência emocional.
  • Comunicação de Alto Nível: Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza para apresentar diagnósticos e planos de ação.
  • Domínio de IA e Tecnologia: Domínio e forte familiaridade prática com ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial (como Gemini, NotebookLM) e agentes de IA para otimização de processos comerciais, construção de prompts eficientes e tomada de decisão fundamentada em dados.
  • Google Workspace: Domínio de planilhas eletrônicas (Google Sheets, Apresentações, Formulários, Drive) para o acompanhamento e consolidação de KPIs de negócio.
  • Necessário CNH Ativa.

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e atingir #Resultados incríveis, por isso, não fazemos distinção para candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar e estética. Queremos ser a empresa onde pessoas escolham como lugar para se desenvolver e contribuir para a realização de sonhos, #AllTogether.

Nós, FoodLovers, temos fome de inovação e resultado. Buscamos sempre fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e atuando com agilidade e responsabilidade! O que a gente espera do Subchefe de Cozinha Sênior?

Buscamos uma pessoa com ensino superior completo em Gastronomia, Nutrição ou áreas correlatas, com experiência consolidada como Subchefe de Cozinha Pleno ou em posições correlatas de liderança. É importante ter vivência na gestão e desenvolvimento de equipes, organização da operação, planejamento e acompanhamento das rotinas de produção, além de conhecimento das normas de segurança alimentar, higiene e boas práticas. Experiências em hotéis, resorts ou operações de grande volume, assim como cursos de aperfeiçoamento em Gastronomia, Gestão de Pessoas ou Segurança Alimentar, serão considerados diferenciais. Valorizamos, ainda, pessoas receptivas às práticas de melhoria contínua, inovação e aperfeiçoamento dos processos da cozinha.

description:
Job description

Estamos construindo uma trajetória de cuidado e excelência e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem desse propósito.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Contabilidade , com experiência em processos contábeis e fiscais, fechamento, demonstrações contábeis e obrigações acessórias, além de conhecimento das normas aplicáveis às Operadoras de Planos de Saúde. Buscamos alguém com visão analítica, liderança e domínio técnico em ANS, DIOPS, provisões técnicas, legislação tributária e auditorias.

Se você se identifica com esse desafio, venha escrever sua trajetória com a gente!

Main responsibilities

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Coordenar, supervisionar e assegurar a execução dos processos contábeis, fiscais e regulatórios da Operadora, garantindo a qualidade, integridade, tempestividade, confiabilidade e conformidade das informações econômico-financeiras e das obrigações legais e regulatórias.

Atuar na gestão técnica e operacional da área, assegurando o cumprimento das normas contábeis, fiscais, tributárias e regulatórias aplicáveis ao segmento de saúde suplementar, especialmente aquelas estabelecidas pela Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar (ANS), bem como pelos demais órgãos competentes e pelo Sistema Unimed.

Responsabilizar-se pelo acompanhamento dos processos, controles internos, indicadores e riscos relacionados às atividades sob sua gestão, promovendo ações preventivas e corretivas, melhorias contínuas e adequações decorrentes de alterações legais, regulatórias ou operacionais. Subsidiar a Gerência Contábil e as instâncias de governança com informações, análises técnicas e indicadores que contribuam para a tomada de decisão e para a adequada gestão econômico-financeira da Operadora.

Atuar como referência técnica da área, coordenando a equipe, orientando as interfaces com as demais áreas da organização, auditorias, consultorias, órgãos reguladores e demais partes interessadas, assegurando a adequada condução das demandas e a efetividade dos processos sob sua responsabilidade.

Coordenar a elaboração, conciliação analítica e transmissão do Documento de Informações de Operadoras de Planos de Saúde (DIOPS/Financeiro) mensais e trimestrais dentro dos prazos legais. Garantir a correta aplicação do Plano de Contas Padrão da ANS e o monitoramento das provisões técnicas regulatórias;

Realizar o preenchimento dos PPA’s trimestrais e prestar todo o suporte necessário a possíveis questionamentos da auditoria independente;

Supervisionar o fechamento contábil mensal e anual da operadora, avaliando balancetes, conciliações e a correta classificação de despesas médico-hospitalares, glosas e receitas de contraprestações e de todas as demais rubricas contábeis. Assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais e estabelecidos pela gestão imediata;

Elaborar as Demonstrações Contábeis completas e notas explicativas exigidas pelo órgão regulador;

Coordenar a apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos (PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL) com foco nas particularidades de deduções da base de cálculo permitidas para operadoras de saúde. Validar e assegurar a entrega de obrigações acessórias vigentes (EFD-Reinf, EFD-Contribuições, DCTF, ECD, ECF, e obgitos municipais de ISS);

Monitorar os atos cooperativos e não cooperativos (Lei 5.764/71), garantindo a adequada segregação e tratamento contábil e tributário dos atos praticados com os médicos cooperados e com terceiros.

Supervisionar o processo de análise e conferência de notas fiscais da rede prestadora credenciada (cooperados, hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios e outros), validando a correta retenção de tributos na fonte (IRRF, CSRF, INSS e ISS) aplicável a serviços de saúde;

Atuar como o principal ponto de contato e prover suporte documental para auditorias externas independentes, auditorias do Sistema Unimed, auditorias médicas e eventuais fiscalizações da Receita Federal, Municípios ou técnicos da ANS, incluindo o suporte para a gerencia contábil nas respostas de ofícios;

Liderar, capacitar e avaliar o desempenho dos especialistas, analistas e assistentes das áreas contábil e fiscal. Desenvolver e revisar procedimentos internos e propor melhorias automatizadas nos sistemas ERP.

Interagir com os fornecedores (internos e externos), visando assegurar que os procedimentos e as políticas da Cooperativa e das Parcerias sejam cumpridos;

Acompanhar e apresentar, na ausência do Gerente Contábil ou superior imediato, os dados e informações contábeis nas reuniões do Conselho Fiscal, Conselho de Administração e Diretoria Executiva, prestando os esclarecimentos necessários;

Elaborar e realizar análise crítica dos indicadores econômico-financeiros da Operadora, subsidiando discussões e decisões junto à Gerência contábil;

Manter-se atualizado quanto à legislação contábil, fiscal e regulatória vigente, especialmente no âmbito da Agência Nacional de Saúde Suplementar (ANS), Receita Federal e demais órgãos das esferas federal e municipal;

Desenvolver indicadores para mensuração do desempenho do setor Contábil/Fiscal, elaborando relatórios de acompanhamento e evolução, bem como apresentar os resultados à Gerência contábil;

Atuar em projetos, demandas especiais e iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas às áreas contábil, fiscal e regulatória, avaliando impactos, riscos, necessidades de adequação de processos e sistemas e propondo soluções que assegurem a conformidade, a eficiência operacional e a qualidade das informações;

Coordenar ou participar de projetos de implantação e melhoria de sistemas, processos e controles que impactem as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando a adequada avaliação dos reflexos contábeis, fiscais, tributários e regulatórios;

Assessorar a Gerência Contábil na avaliação de riscos, oportunidades e impactos decorrentes de alterações normativas, decisões administrativas, mudanças de processos ou situações extraordinárias que possam afetar a Operadora

Exercer outras atividades inerentes à natureza e ao nível de responsabilidade do cargo, ainda que não descritas de forma específica neste documento, desde que relacionadas ao escopo de atuação da área e às necessidades da organização.

Requirements and skills

Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, pós-graduação ou MBA em Contabilidade ou áreas afins e registro ativo no CRC.

Experiência com gestão de equipes e em contabilidade de Operadoras de Planos de Saúde ou no segmento de Saúde Suplementar, bem como com regime de Lucro Real e atuação com auditorias.

Conhecimento em normas da ANS, DIOPS, Plano de Contas Padrão, provisões técnicas, fechamento contábil, demonstrações contábeis, obrigações acessórias e legislação tributária.

We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

We're looking for an Account Executive to spearhead our growth in Recife . In this role, you will be instrumental in expanding Clara’s footprint by identifying high-value business opportunities, nurturing strategic client relationships, and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your contributions will directly impact our mission to revolutionize spend management for companies across Latin America.

Drive Sales Growth: Own the end-to-end sales cycle, identifying and pursuing new business opportunities to expand Clara's client base in the Northeast region.

Leverage Local Network: Utilize your existing relationships and deep understanding of the Recife business ecosystem—specifically among decision-makers in finance and operations to generate high-quality leads.

Manage Sales Pipeline: Oversee lead generation, qualification, and closing, ensuring a consistent and predictable flow of new partnerships.

Strategic Relationship Management: Act as a trusted advisor to clients, understanding their complex financial needs and providing tailored solutions via the Clara platform.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing and Product teams to align local market insights with our broader growth strategy, using tools like Hubspot to track and optimize your impact.

Operational Excellence: Use Google Drive and automated workflows to maintain rigorous documentation and performance tracking.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

Minimum 5 years of experience in high-growth sales environments (SaaS or Fintech preferred).

Local Expertise: Currently based in Recife with a strong, active network among finance leaders and key influencers in the region.

Communication: Working proficiency in English and Portuguese.

Execution: Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and managing complex negotiations independently.

Adaptability: Ability to thrive in fast-changing environments and operate with high ownership.

Tech-Savvy: Experience or strong interest in using AI tools and automation (like N8N or Slack ) to improve sales workflows.

Nice to haves:

Technical Skills: Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL , or Python .

Language: Basic proficiency in Spanish or a desire to learn.

Tools: Prior experience using Amplemarket or Hubspot for outbound prospecting.

A good sense of humor.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

#Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

About the role:

Under the direction of the Senior Regional Engineering Manager, the Project Engineer will play a pivotal role in overseeing and executing capital projects (CapEx) within a dynamic multinational food industry environment. This role sits within a multidisciplinary Engineering department that supports the Manufacturing Operations for Barry Callebaut’s Cocoa Business Units in Brazil.

This role encompasses the full spectrum of project management responsibilities, beginning with the initial concept and feasibility studies, extending through engineering design, procurement, and into the implementation phase of the project lifecycle. The individual will be instrumental in translating business needs into actionable project plans, ensuring successful project delivery while adhering to industry standards and company policies. The Senior Project Engineer is expected to foster a culture of excellence and innovation, driving teams towards achieving strategic objectives, and preparing themselves as a natural pipeline for engineering management.

This position will be based in Itabuna, Bahia, Brazil, but will also support a second factory in Ilhéus, Bahia, requiring travel between the plants when necessary. As part of the Engineering organization, active information and data exchange with Corporate and Global COE teams will be a core aspect of the position.

The main stakeholders for this position will be all the departments present at the sites, including Plant Managers, Quality Assurance, HSE, HR, Maintenance, R&D, Supply Chain, and Production teams.

The core mission of this position relies on deep technical and managerial skills to ensure the adoption of high-level engineering standards in all capital projects. It requires strong management of timeline and costs, owning a robust and well-designed communication plan, creating synergy between departments, and securing the buy-in of all teams involved. This position will lead internal and outsourced teams working on a wide range of capital projects, from layout improvements to complex brownfield or greenfield project execution.This is a high-visibility position within the organization, offering a solid career path and succession pipeline to engineering management within Barry Callebaut, the world's leading manufacturer of high-quality chocolate and cocoa products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead, mentor, and oversee the work of internal engineers, outsourced engineering companies, and technical staff, exercising strong technical and administrative leadership;
  • Improve existing frameworks and establish new engineering standards, internal work instructions, and quality control procedures for the department;
  • Act as the lead Project Manager on construction and infrastructure expansion projects; establish priorities, track project budgets, deploy robust project governance (such as staged-gate processes), and direct the work of consultants and contractors;
  • Administer contracts, evaluate engineering deliverables, and approve milestone payments to contractors and vendors;
  • Foster and promote an equitable, inclusive, and respectful workplace environment that values multicultural teamwork;
  • Review and approve technical designs, engineering studies, technical reports, and specifications, ensuring formal alignment and approval from all main stakeholders;
  • Proactively obtain and integrate stakeholder input during planning, design, and construction phases; participate in steering committees and represent the Engineering function in operational decisions;
  • Collaborate with the management team to plan, organize, and allocate resources to complete projects within defined budgets and schedules; lead the development of competitive bidding documents and participate in contract awards;
  • Ensure project completion in full compliance with work plans, as well as federal, state, and local laws, regulations, environmental ordinances, and safety codes;
  • Partner with the Procurement team to drive strategic sourcing, selection, and management of contractors and suppliers, ensuring cost-effective project execution;
  • Lead comprehensive Risk Management strategies, identifying potential bottlenecks early, developing mitigation plans, and creating contingency scenarios to manage project uncertainties;
  • Lead budget estimation for the site's CapEx Mid-Term Plan (MTP), reporting directly to and validating financial strategies with the Engineering Manager.

Scope :

  • The scope of work will be primarily performed at our cocoa plant in Itabuna, with extended support to the Ilhéus facility;
  • This role contributes to and supervises the strategic CapEx portfolio for the designated sites, playing a critical role in regional business growth;
  • Internal project engineering staff and outsourced engineering teams assigned to the projects will report directly to this position;
  • Crucial accountability for establishing a highly communicative environment, utilizing adequate tracking tools, and ensuring that stakeholder needs are fully met throughout the project lifecycle.

About you:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Control & Automation, or related fields) is required. A Master's degree (MS or MBA) is considered a strong asset;
  • 10+ years of progressive engineering project management experience within the FMCG, food process, or consumer goods industry;
  • Solid, proven experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and executing large-scale CapEx projects;
  • Advanced/Fluent proficiency in English (essential for corporate and global communication); fluency in Portuguese is required;
  • High proficiency in Project Management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera) and familiarity with Engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) and ERP systems (SAP);
  • Strong background in process automation, utilities/infrastructure, or civil/construction within an industrial environment;
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences;
  • Experience or exposure to international manufacturing environments and corporate engineering standards is highly desirable;
  • PMP® (Project Management Professional) certification is a plus.

Building on our past. Ready for the future

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We're bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.

Purpose

The Principal Piping Engineer provides senior technical leadership and subject matter expertise in piping engineering across medium to large, complex capital projects. This role serves as a discipline authority within Worley, responsible for technical excellence, mentorship of piping engineers, and ensuring piping design solutions meet project, regulatory, safety, and quality requirements. The Principal Piping Engineer works closely with project leadership, discipline leads, and clients to deliver high-value engineering outcomes across the full project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Project Delivery

Serve as the Piping Engineering discipline lead on medium to large projects, providing technical direction and oversight to teams of piping engineers and designers.

Lead the development and approval of piping engineering philosophies, specifications, design criteria, and technical standards.

Provide technical assurance across all phases of project delivery, from concept and FEED through detailed design, construction support, and commissioning.

Act as a senior technical authority for complex piping layouts, materials selection, stress analysis inputs, constructability reviews, and regulatory compliance.

Ensure piping designs meet Worley standards, client requirements, applicable codes, and statutory/regulatory obligations.

Project Controls & Stakeholder Engagement

Work collaboratively with Project Management, other engineering disciplines, and clients to deliver projects safely, on schedule, and within budget.

Support project planning activities, including development of scopes of work, engineering estimates, execution strategies, schedules, and staffing plans.

Monitor progress of piping deliverables against approved budgets and schedules; proactively identify risks, constraints, and opportunities for improvement.

Apply change management processes and contribute to scope, cost, and schedule impact assessments as required.

Provide technical input to proposals, tenders, and pursuit activities.

Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement

Promote engineering excellence, quality assurance, and consistent application of Worley systems, processes, and tools.

Participate in technical reviews, design assurance processes, and constructability and operability reviews.

Stay current with industry best practices, emerging technologies, regulatory changes, and evolving piping design methodologies.

Contribute to the development and improvement of discipline procedures, standards, templates, and work practices.

Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to intermediate and senior piping engineers.

Support the development of technical capability and succession planning within the piping discipline.

Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture.

Coordinate resource requirements with the Piping Engineering portfolio or functional leadership team.

Qualifications - What You Will Bring

Technical & Industry Experience

Extensive experience in piping engineering within EPC, EPCM, consulting, or operating environments.

Demonstrated experience acting as a piping discipline lead on medium to large, technically complex projects.

Strong knowledge of piping design principles, materials, specifications, layout development, and construction interfaces.

Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards, including but not limited to:

ASME / ASTM piping codes and standards

ABSA requirements for piping design and registration in Alberta

CSA pipeline standards (considered an asset)

Familiarity with multi-disciplinary project environments and interfaces with process, mechanical, structural, electrical, and civil disciplines.

Experience providing engineering support during procurement, construction, and commissioning, including MRQs, technical bid evaluations, RFIs, and site support.

Stress analysis experience and exposure to complex piping systems is considered an asset.

EPC/EPCM project delivery experience is an asset.

Digital & Tools

Proficiency with piping engineering and design tools, as well as standard engineering software and MS Office applications.

Experience working within integrated engineering data environments and document control systems is considered an asset.

Professional Attributes

Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence, guide, and mentor technical teams.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients, project teams, and senior stakeholders.

About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Purpose

The Senior or Principal Electrical Engineer provides high-quality electrical engineering services to Worley and its customers across large and complex industrial projects. The role is responsible for the technical execution and leadership of electrical engineering activities, ensuring delivery meets project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and applicable technical and regulatory requirements.

The position may act as the Electrical Engineering Lead for assigned projects or defined scopes and provides technical guidance, coordination, and mentorship to engineers and designers within the electrical engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute electrical engineering activities on assigned projects or defined project scopes, ensuring compliance with Worley, client, statutory, regulatory, and applicable international standards.
  • Manage electrical engineering requirements and deliverables to meet project scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives.
  • Act as the Electrical Engineering Lead on specific projects or scopes, including defining requirements, assigning tasks, coordinating workshare, and monitoring progress.
  • Participate in project and discipline meetings, provide technical input, prepare progress reports, and comply with required checking, quality assurance, and document control procedures.
  • Ensure project scope is clearly defined and that technical and scope changes are managed in accordance with established change management processes.
  • Coordinate electrical engineering activities with multidisciplinary teams, including process, instrumentation, mechanical, piping, automation, and construction, to ensure integrated project delivery.
  • Provide technical support throughout procurement, construction, and commissioning activities, including:
    • Preparation and review of electrical equipment and material requisitions.
    • Technical bid evaluations.
    • Review of vendor documentation.
    • Technical review of purchase orders and procurement documentation.
    • Resolution of technical issues arising during construction and commissioning.
  • Develop, review, and approve electrical engineering deliverables, calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical documentation as required.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between Worley, client, and project requirements, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Proactively identify technical risks and issues, develop practical engineering solutions, and provide timely recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and support to intermediate and junior engineers and designers.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams, clients, vendors, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Promote effective workshare execution and coordinate work across project locations and engineering teams where applicable.
  • Maintain current knowledge of electrical engineering standards, industry practices, emerging technologies, and technical innovations.
  • Support continuous improvement of electrical engineering processes, tools, and technical practices.
  • Accredited Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; APEGA P.Eng. registration or eligibility required.
  • Significant electrical engineering experience on large, complex, multidisciplinary industrial projects, preferably in energy, mining, chemicals, power, or infrastructure.
  • Proven experience leading electrical engineering scope, deliverables, and activities across multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong technical skills in electrical design, calculations, drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles, design practices, codes, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience developing and reviewing electrical deliverables, including SLDs, load lists, MCCs, cable schedules, layouts, grounding, lighting, hazardous areas, MTOs, and work packages.
  • Strong knowledge of LV/MV distribution, motor control and protection, VFDs, emergency power, grounding, lightning protection, and hazardous area design.
  • Experience with electrical power system studies, engineering workflows, and document management systems such as SAP, KMS, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of process safety, HAZOP/LOPA, scope definition, workshare, and TA/NTA execution models.
  • Strong communication, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across project teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, exercise sound engineering judgment, and deliver safe, high-quality results.

Ability to mentor engineers and designers, provide technical direction, and contribute to continuous improvement.

Er du svejser og vil du have fast arbejde på et værksted med styr på tingene?

Vi mangler en svejser i Lem til reparation, klargøring og kvalitetstjek.

Du lander i en større produktion, hvor der bliver lavet redskaber til entreprenør og landbrug. Det er værkstedsarbejde med metal, reparation og praktisk sans for det der skal holde. Mange dele fremstilles internt, så svejsningen hænger tæt sammen med resten af produktionen. Holdet beskriver sig selv som jordnært, ærligt og omgængeligt, og der bliver lagt vægt på at hjælpe hinanden når der er travlt.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have en stabil hverdag og bruge hænderne på noget robust. Du skal kunne tage en reparation seriøst, klargøre ordentligt og tjekke dit eget arbejde bagefter. Lønnen ligger på 190-210 kr. i timen, og der er tale om fastansættelse.

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

I hverdagen handler det om at få svejsningen gjort klar, udført og tjekket ordentligt. Du klargør emner før svejsning, løser reparationer og følger op med efterarbejde, så fejl bliver fanget før emnet går videre.

  • Forbereder og klargør emner før svejsning

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to continue the development and extension of an internal developer portal and dashboard, working heavily on a custom Java backend while maintaining and potentially rewriting the frontend using TypeScript. You will integrate the application with Snowflake, relational, and non-relational database environments, design and implement RESTful APIs, and ensure code quality through unit testing and performance profiling. The role requires 4+ years of Java backend experience with TypeScript frontend flexibility and the ability to architect a potential frontend rewrite.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Continue the development and extension of the internal developer portal and dashboard.
  • Work heavily on a custom Java backend to ensure robust server-side performance.
  • Maintain the existing frontend architecture while planning and executing a potential rewrite using TypeScript.
  • Integrate the application with diverse database environments, specifically Snowflake, relational, and non-relational databases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate user requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Ensure code quality through comprehensive unit testing, code reviews, and performance profiling.

MUST HAVES

  • At least 4+ years of experience in backend development using Java .
  • Frontend development experience using TypeScript .
  • Experience integrating with diverse database environments, specifically Snowflake, relational, and non-relational databases .
  • Flexibility to architect and potentially execute a frontend rewrite.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful API design and implementation.
  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git ).
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Familiarity with modern component-based UI frameworks (such as React or Angular) to support the TypeScript rewrite.
  • Understanding of cloud architecture and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience operating within an Agile/Scrum environment.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth : Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation : We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

At Oxford University Press, we believe education changes lives.

We are looking for a commercially driven Educational Consultant to grow our presence, develop strategic partnerships, and help educational institutions achieve their learning goals through our solutions and resources.

This position could be based in Fortaleza or Recife and this role is ideal for professionals who enjoy building relationships, identifying opportunities, developing new business, and creating value for customers through consultative sales.

About the Role

As an Educational Consultant, you will be responsible for driving business growth within your assigned territory by developing new opportunities, expanding existing partnerships, and delivering customer-focused solutions.

You will work closely with schools, educational groups, and decision-makers, acting as a trusted advisor while managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to implementation.

Success in this role requires a strong customer-facing mindset, commercial acumen, resilience, and the ability to build long-term partnerships in a dynamic and competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a territory growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Identify, prospect, and convert new business opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with educational leaders and key stakeholders.
  • Conduct customer meetings, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend tailored educational solutions.
  • Manage the full sales pipeline, ensuring consistent follow-up and conversion of opportunities.
  • Retain and grow existing accounts through proactive account management.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Accurately maintain customer and opportunity information in CRM systems.
  • Achieve and exceed territory sales targets and business goals.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in sales, business development, account management, or customer-facing commercial roles.
  • Demonstrated success in prospecting, opening new accounts, and generating business growth.
  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to influence and engage multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Results-oriented mindset with strong planning and execution capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently while managing a sales territory.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Availability for regular travel within the region.

Preferred

  • Experience in Education, ELT, EdTech, Publishing, or Learning Solutions.
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian education sector.
  • Experience selling complex solutions, services, or subscription-based products.
  • Existing network within educational institutions.

Who You Are

You are someone who:

  • Enjoys creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.
  • Is motivated by achieving results and driving growth.
  • Builds trust quickly and develops strong professional relationships.
  • Demonstrates resilience, persistence, and adaptability.
  • Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.
  • Is curious, learns quickly, and continuously seeks improvement.

Why Join Oxford University Press?

Joining OUP means becoming part of a global organization with a shared mission to advance education and learning worldwide. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your career in a collaborative, purpose-driven environment.

If you are passionate about sales, relationship building, and making a difference through education, we would love to hear from you.

Reporting Manager Title : Senior Associate Technical Consultant, Water Scientist

Technical Consultant, Water Scientist

Play an integral role in Worley’s Environmental & Sustainability (E&S) team, supporting critical environmental monitoring programs for a leading oil sands operation in Fort McMurray, Alberta. This is an exciting early‑career opportunity to contribute to sustainable resource development while gaining hands‑on field experience, collaborating with experienced professionals, and building a strong foundation in environmental consulting.

Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will help collect, manage, and communicate environmental data that supports regulatory compliance, environmental stewardship, and informed decision-making. Your contributions will directly support safe, efficient, and high‑quality project delivery while advancing your technical and professional development.

Purpose of the role

Join our dynamic team as a Technical Consultant, Water Scientist . In this role, you will support environmental field programs focused on groundwater and surface water monitoring for a major oil sands operation. You will work closely with experienced technical specialists and project teams to execute environmental monitoring activities, maintain high safety standards, and deliver reliable data and reporting that support our client’s environmental commitments and business objectives.

This position provides a unique opportunity to develop technical expertise, gain exposure to complex environmental projects, and establish a rewarding career within one of the world’s leading consulting and professional services organizations.

Location: Fort McMurray, Alberta, Canada

This role follows a 14 - days - on , 14-days-off rotation , including mobilization and demobilization . Accommodation is provided at a lodge near the client site during rotations, and travel is required to support environmental field programs . Candidates may be based in Edmonton or Calgary and fly in/out to Fort McMurray.

You will be responsible for

  • Supporting groundwater and surface water sampling and environmental monitoring programs in accordance with established procedures and project requirements.
  • Collecting, documenting, and managing field data accurately and efficiently while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Working under the guidance of experienced field supervisors and technical specialists to execute environmental monitoring activities safely and effectively.
  • Assisting in the preparation of technical reports, data summaries, and presentations for project teams and clients.
  • Supporting field activity tracking, documentation, and reporting requirements.
  • Participating actively in health, safety, and environmental programs, including safety meetings, hazard assessments, and field documentation.
  • Monitoring environmental and wildlife conditions, including bear awareness and observation activities, to help maintain safe field operations.
  • Maintaining compliance with client, regulatory, and Worley safety and quality requirements.
  • Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to support successful project execution and delivery.
  • Representing Worley professionally while building positive working relationships with colleagues, contractors, and client stakeholders.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Engineering, Diploma in Natural Resource Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  • Environmental monitoring or environmental technician training is considered beneficial.
  • Junior or graduate-level experience supporting environmental field monitoring, sampling, data collection, or reporting activities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to communicate effectively with project teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work safely and productively in remote field environments and wilderness settings.
  • Physical capability to work outdoors, navigate uneven terrain, and perform field activities in varying weather conditions.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high‑quality work.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within team‑based project environments.
  • Previous environmental consulting experience is considered an asset.
  • Familiarity with Argo operation is considered an asset.

About Us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI‑enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today’s needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values‑inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we’re not just talking about it; we’re doing it. We’re reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today’s low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change. #LI-NM4

description:
The Analyst XFN (REMIR & Executive Protection) at Nubank's Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is a cross-functional role responsible for supporting both Risk Event Monitoring & Incident Response (REMIR) and Executive Protection (EP) operations.

This professional acts as a key connector between operational monitoring, crisis response, and executive protection logistics, ensuring that all activities are executed with precision, discretion, and adherence to Nubank's safety standards.

The role requires a proactive mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to work under pressure while coordinating between multiple stakeholders and time-sensitive missions.

The analyst will monitor risk events in real time, support executive movements, and ensure that critical information is communicated accurately to the right teams, at the right time.

Role Tasks And Responsibilities

REMIR (Risk Event Monitoring & Incident Response)

  • Monitor real-time events that may impact operations, employees, or executives, ensure rapid assessment and escalation when required.
  • Draft and distribute alerts, notifications, and Situational Reports (SARs) through established communication channels, including Everbridge.
  • Coordinate with Facilities, Safety, and external emergency services during incidents to ensure an effective and aligned response.
  • Collect, validate, and analyze critical information from multiple sources, filtering noise and ensuring the accuracy of reports shared with GSOC leadership.
  • Support crisis management activities, including post-incident reporting and After-Action Reviews (AARs).

Executive Protection (EP)

  • Support the planning, monitoring, and execution of executive travel, events, and daily operations.
  • Monitor flight schedules, itineraries, and travel routes in real time, identifying potential disruptions, delays, or security concerns.
  • Conduct OSINT research to identify potential threats or risks affecting executive travel and activities.
  • Coordinate with vendors, drivers, and Executive Protection personnel to ensure operational readiness and seamless execution.
  • Provide real-time situational awareness and maintain continuous communication between GSOC and Executive Protection teams during missions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of Executive Protection activities, including briefings, logistics records, and post-mission summaries.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as a communication link between REMIR, Executive Protection, and other Corporate Security functions.
  • Collaborate with Strategic and Tactical Intelligence teams to ensure executive missions and crisis responses are supported by relevant intelligence insights.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of SOPs, playbooks, and communication protocols across REMIR and Executive Protection operations.
  • Support the Documentation and Quality Assurance Lead in maintaining process consistency and capturing lessons learned for ongoing operational improvement.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Security Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; advanced Spanish is highly desirable.
  • Experience in security operations, crisis management, or executive protection support.
  • Familiarity with incident response tools (e.g., Everbridge), CCTV platforms, and access control systems.
  • Knowledge of OSINT methodologies and the ability to assess open-source data for risk identification.
  • Strong communication, coordination, and multitasking skills in high-pressure environments.
  • Proven attention to detail, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive information.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience working in corporate GSOCs or similar 24/7 operational environments.
  • Knowledge of risk assessment frameworks and executive security best practices.
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with reporting and visualization tools (Power BI, Looker Studio, etc.).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions during time-critical events.

description:
Job description

Estamos à procura de um(a) Analista de Dados e Processos (Frotas) para integrar nosso time de Inteligência de Frotas na Brisanet. Em uma operação de telecomunicações de grande escala, a eficiência da nossa frota impacta diretamente a ponta. Você será responsável por transformar dados operacionais e financeiros em insights estratégicos, construindo dashboards, automatizando relatórios e estruturando integrações (APIs) entre nosso sistema de frotas e os sistemas internos.

Não é necessário conhecimento prévio em mecânica automotiva — buscamos um perfil altamente analítico, focado em resolução de problemas, forte em dados, lógica de programação e visão de processos end-to-end. Se você gosta de investigar anomalias, desenhar fluxos inteligentes, garantir a qualidade da informação e apoiar decisões orçamentárias com base em dados concretos, a Brisanet é o seu lugar!

Vamos velejar rumo ao futuro! #VemSerBrisanet

Main responsibilities

  • Mapear e estruturar o fluxo de dados via integrações (APIs) entre a plataforma de gestão de frotas e os sistemas corporativos, garantindo a automação e integridade das informações;
  • Realizar análises de causa raiz (Troubleshooting/RCA): investigar desvios no orçamento, anomalias de consumo ou custos de manutenção, traduzindo dados brutos em planos de ação;
  • Garantir a governança e qualidade dos dados (Data Quality), identificando falhas de preenchimento nos sistemas de origem e propondo melhorias nos processos de coleta;
  • Construir e manter dashboards dinâmicos em ferramentas de BI (Power BI/Looker) para o acompanhamento de KPIs operacionais e financeiros;
  • Escrever e otimizar consultas em SQL para extração, cruzamento e consolidação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Traduzir regras de negócio e necessidades da operação de frotas em lógica de programação e fluxos sistêmicos;
  • Desenvolver simuladores de custos e modelos analíticos para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de eficiência (ex: redução de ociosidade, otimização de rotas/consumo);
  • Apoiar o desenho de processos ("As-Is" e "To-Be") da área, buscando eliminar trabalhos manuais e planilhas paralelas;
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos com foco em indicadores financeiros e apoio ao planejamento orçamentário da área;
  • Vivenciar a identidade organizacional do Grupo Brisanet.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior completo (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas);
  • Perfil altamente analítico e investigativo (facilidade para conectar pontos, identificar padrões em grandes bases de dados e propor soluções lógicas);
  • Domínio avançado de SQL para consulta, estruturação e manipulação de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático no consumo e integração de APIs (REST, JSON, XML) para conexão entre plataformas;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou Looker);
  • Visão sistêmica e conhecimento em mapeamento de processos e fluxos de trabalho;
  • Noções de gestão orçamentária, análise de custos e indicadores financeiros/operacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de planilhas eletrônicas (Excel / Google Sheets) e pacote Google/MS Office.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise e automação de processos (Python ou R);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de desenho de fluxos (BPMN, Bizagi, Visio, Draw.io, Lucidchart);
  • Vivência na criação de pipelines de dados (ETL) e arquitetura de dados;
  • Experiência prévia com dados logísticos, telecomunicações ou operações de grande escala.

Additional information

  • Eventos internos que abordam temas diversos;

description:
Momentum Financial Services Group (formerly Money Mart Financial Services) is a leading North American financial services company and one of Canada’s top non-prime lenders. For more than 40 years, we’ve committed to helping consumers and business owners access the money they need when they need it most, meeting people where they are and helping close the gap between their financial needs and goals.

Through our trusted Money Mart® brand in Canada and United States, we proudly serve customers across a network of over 400 retail locations and growing digital channels. Our products and services include personal lending, payday loans, installment loans, cheque and check cashing, money transfers, prepaid cards, currency exchange, and other everyday financial solutions for individuals and businesses.

At Money Mart, we understand that not every customer fit with-in traditional banking or prime lending models. That’s why our teams look beyond the credit score to provide accessible, responsible financial solutions with respect, transparency, and care. Whether customers visit us online, in branch, or through our mobile app, we focus on delivering practical support, clear information, and service that helps people and business owners move forward with confidence.

We believe in giving back to the communities where we live and work. With the generous support of our customers and team members, we proudly contribute each year to local charities and nonprofit organizations, while also using our time and talent to serve local communities across Canada and the United States.

Our people are at the heart of our business. We’re committed to building inclusive teams, supporting the communities where we live and work, and creating a workplace where employees can grow, make an impact, and help customers navigate everyday financial needs. If you’re passionate about customer service, relationship building, and helping consumers and business owners access financial solutions when they need them most, you’ll find a meaningful career with Momentum Financial Services Group.

What we Offer:

  • Monthly bonus potential based on the operational success you drive

Other Benefits Include:

  • And Much More!

Branch location: 264 Erie St South Unit B

GENERAL FUNCTION

Financial Service Representatives support Money Mart customers by understanding their financial needs and connecting them with suitable products and services. In this role, Team Members interview customers for personal lending products, review application and financial information, recommend appropriate solutions, sell related financial products and services, complete transactions, maintain accurate records, and support payment arrangements for existing accounts.

This role combines sales, customer service, personal lending, compliance, cash handling, and branch operations. Team Members must deliver excellent customer service while following company policies, regulatory requirements, and responsible lending practices.

Retail Team Members generally perform their duties within a secured work area protected by bullet-resistant glass and a controlled-access mantrap. Once hired, all retail Team Members will complete an internal multi-week Ready to Work Alone (RTWA) certification before working independently.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide friendly, professional, and accurate customer service by assessing customer needs, completing transactions, answering questions, and identifying opportunities to promote and cross-sell products and services.
  • Promote, recommend, and process loans, credit cards, cheque cashing, money transfers, money orders, bill payments, and other related products and services based on the customer’s needs, financial circumstances, and applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Consistently identify cross-selling and referral opportunities during every customer interaction to increase product awareness, meet customer needs, and achieve individual and branch sales goals.
  • Clearly explain product and service features, benefits, fees, repayment terms, payment options, renewals, refinancing options, and other important information using approved marketing materials.
  • Collect, review, verify, and document required customer identification, financial, application, and supporting information to process products and services, ensuring all applications/transactions are complete, compliant, and accurately recorded.
  • Monitor and maintain complete and accurate customer information and records in all required systems.
  • Contact customers with past-due accounts to discuss and negotiate payment arrangements within authorized guidelines.
  • Follow all company policies and regulatory requirements, including Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF), privacy, Recordable Transactions, fraud prevention, and all relevant procedures.
  • Accurately process cash, POS transactions, and financial service transactions.
  • Reconcile the cash drawer at the end of each shift, and follow all cash handling, safety, and security procedures.
  • Work with the branch team to maintain the branch appearance, cleanliness, and customer-ready environment.
  • Support branch opening and closing procedures, including completing all required paperwork accurately.
  • Complete all other job-related duties as directed by Management.
  • Maintain availability to work flexible shifts, including evenings and weekends.

EDUCATION :

  • High School diploma or equivalent

WORK EXPERIENCE

  • One or more years of experience as a Retail Sales Associate, Sales Representative or similar role.
  • One or more years of experience in customer service and cash handling.
  • Hands-on experience with POS transactions.
  • Track record of achieving sales goals preferred.

SKILLS

  • Customer service-focused mindset with the ability to build rapport, deliver exceptional service, and create a positive customer experience.
  • Sales-focused approach with the ability to identify customer needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve sales objectives through cross-selling opportunities.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and perform well under pressure.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify customer needs, resolve concerns, and provide effective solutions in a professional and timely manner.
  • Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic knowledge and experience with Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, and Outlook).

Please note: The pay range for this position is between $18.00 to $20.50 per hour with an additional monthly store bonus opportunity of up to $590 dependent on store size, individual performance and achievement of store KPIs.

At Money Mart, we are committed to building innovative solutions grounded in ethical, transparent, and responsible use of data and technology. Aligned with the principles outlined in Canada’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA), we take a proactive approach to ensuring that any AI or data-driven systems we use are safe, fair, and accountable.

This posting is for a current positionwithin our organization, offering the opportunity to contribute to meaningful, responsible innovation that supports our employees, clients, and communities.

description:
Sobre a Olos
A Olos é uma empresa brasileira focada em oferecer soluções tecnológicas que potencializem o relacionamento entre empresas e seus clientes. A partir de ampla experiência em operações de Televendas, Cobrança, SAC e Helpdesk, a plataforma Olos unifica os canais de comunicação e promove o gerenciamento completo da jornada do cliente, com uma solução omnichannel robusta. Fundada em 2010, a Olos cresceu mantendo o espírito de startup, com inovação, resiliência e foco em resultados.

Principais responsabilidades
Gerir estrategicamente o ciclo de pagamentos e atuar como um verdadeiro parceiro de negócios das áreas internas e fornecedores. Você será responsável por garantir o processamento ágil e impecável das obrigações financeiras no ERP Omie, otimizar prazos de pagamento, aplicar conhecimentos sólidos de matemática financeira em negociações e assegurar o rigor da conciliação bancária, apoiando diretamente a saúde e a previsibilidade do fluxo de caixa da companhia.

  • Gestão de Pagamentos e Domínio do Omie: Liderar a rotina de contas a pagar com autonomia total no ecossistema Omie, garantindo a correta inserção de notas fiscais, classificações financeiras, rateios por centro de custo e provisionamentos.
  • Relacionamento Estratégico e Negociação: Atuar com excelente desenvoltura na comunicação diária com fornecedores e áreas solicitantes internas, resolvendo pendências com agilidade e renegociando prazos ou condições de pagamento de forma resolutiva e profissional.
  • Matemática Financeira e Retenções: Aplicar matemática financeira para análise de viabilidade de pagamentos antecipados (cálculo de descontos) ou gestão de atrasos (cálculo de juros e multas), além de garantir a correta aplicação e conferência de retenções tributárias (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).
  • Gestão do Fluxo de Caixa (DPO): Estruturar, monitorar e otimizar a régua de pagamentos para maximizar o DPO (Days Payable Outstanding), apoiando a tesouraria na elaboração de projeções financeiras confiáveis.
  • Conciliação e Compliance Bancário: Controlar as remessas e retornos de arquivos CNAB (pagamentos e varredura), executar conciliações bancárias diárias e solucionar divergências junto aos bancos, garantindo que o Omie reflita fielmente as saídas do caixa.
  • Análise e Melhoria de Processos: Elaborar relatórios de aging de fornecedores e estruturar fluxos de aprovação de despesas, identificando gargalos e propondo automações para ganho de escala;

Requisitos Indispensáveis

O que não pode faltar

  • Formação superior completa em Matemática, Estatística, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio absoluto em Faturamento no ERP Omie: É imprescindível saber lançar, classificar e baixar títulos com total autonomia, segurança e domínio técnico no módulo de Contas a Pagar do sistema.
  • Relacionamento: Habilidade comprovada de comunicação fluida, negociação e trato comercial direto com clientes (B2B) e áreas internas.
  • Experiência prévia em Contas a Pagar: Bagagem profunda em Gestão de Régua de Cobrança e rotinas de Conciliação Bancária.
  • Matemática Financeira e Excel: Domínio em cálculos financeiros e Excel Avançado para análise de dados.

title: Communications Associate em maceió (AL)
description:
Drive UNOPS' global presence and impact through compelling content creation and strategic communication initiatives.

About the Region

In Latin America and the Caribbean, UNOPS operates across 23 countries, delivering high-impact solutions that drive sustainable development. UNOPS focuses on building and improving resilient infrastructure—including roads, bridges, public facilities, sanitation systems, and housing—to enhance quality of life and foster inclusive growth. UNOPS also supports public health by procuring essential medicines and medical equipment, ensuring broader access to healthcare services. By strengthening institutional capacities, UNOPS promotes transparent, efficient, and equitable public management. As a trusted partner to governments and development stakeholders, UNOPS aligns its interventions with national priorities, helping countries advance the Sustainable Development Goals through practical, results-driven support.

About the Country/Multi-Country Office

Based in Brazil, the UNOPS Southern Cone Multi-Country Office (SCMCO) also oversees operations in Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay, supporting national priorities and development goals across the subregion. In Argentina, UNOPS strengthens public institutions by providing technical assistance in planning, procurement, and oversight of infrastructure projects—particularly in public buildings—and building capacity in public procurement, with a focus on technological innovation. In Brazil, where UNOPS has operated since 2012, the office collaborates with UN agencies, financial institutions, and government bodies at all levels to deliver services in health, education, urbanization, social rehabilitation, PPPs, and institutional strengthening. UNOPS has played a key role in responding to the COVID-19 pandemic and currently manages 17 active projects across the country. Its work emphasizes transparency, operational efficiency, and results-driven management while aligning with the strategic and operational needs of its partners. Across the Southern Cone, UNOPS promotes sustainable development by enhancing national capabilities and supporting the delivery of high-impact, inclusive infrastructure.

Job Specific Context

Role Purpose

The Communications Associate contributes to developing and implementing communication efforts to enhance UNOPS’ visibility and reputation. The position is responsible for creating and editing a wide range of content, including web stories, press releases and social media posts, ensuring all materials align with corporate style and partner requirements. The incumbent also supports external communications and media relations, helping to coordinate events and campaigns. The Communications Associate is a proactive professional who can manage content production, assist with communications planning, and provide essential administrative support related to communication plans.

Functions / Key Results Expected

Communications Implementation and Visibility

  • Assist in identifying opportunities to strengthen visibility and outreach nationally, regionally and globally.
  • Ensure communication deliverables meet partner/donor visibility requirements and UNOPS guidelines.
  • Support the implementation of project communication strategies and stakeholder mapping.
  • Contribute to crafting project narratives aligned with UNOPS corporate style.

Content Development and Production

  • Draft, edit and proof-read communication materials: web stories, newsletters, press releases, reports and social-media content.
  • Support production of multi-media products (infographics, videos, photos), ensuring message consistency.
  • Coordinate communication inputs for events, workshops and campaigns.

A EuroChem é uma empresa jovem, que deseja atrair pessoas com a mesma energia vibrante e em sintonia com o nosso DNA de crescimento. Assim, buscamos os melhores talentos para estarem conosco nesta jornada de expansão.

Oferecemos também oportunidades de aprendizados contínuos, porque entendemos que esta é uma condição fundamental para nos tornarmos referência no mercado. Além disso, temos o compromisso de sempre buscar soluções que tragam melhorias para a nossa força de trabalho, com foco no nosso principal ativo: as pessoas.

Aqui, você será o protagonista da nossa história. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! Com você, avançaremos cada vez mais.

Main responsibilities

  • Assegurar a implementação e manutenção da Política Ambiental da empresa;

  • Administrar a equipe de trabalho, selecionando, orientando, treinando, acompanhando a atuação, avaliando o desempenho, divulgando e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos/normas relativos à empresa, processo de trabalho e aos sistemas de gestão implementados, bem como interagindo com os outros assuntos envolvendo a gestão de pessoal;
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas à sua função e aos procedimentos do setor de meio ambiente e seu processo de trabalho.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em áreas relacionadas;
  • Sólida experiência na área de Meio Ambiente;
  • Obrigações ambientais multi Estados;

  • Conhecimentos em legislação Estadual, Federal, dentre outras;
